prompt:
Create ONE VFX texture for Gemwoven, a polished jewel fantasy match-3 phone game, in the same hand-painted luminous fire style as the bottom-left "fire vortex" of the attached reference sheet.

ONE top-down clockwise fire vortex whose overall silhouette is a ROUND DISC (a circle, not a square): five or six bold curling orange-gold flame arms spiral inward toward an open dark centre, and their outer ends sweep around the rim so the outline is circular and even all the way round, like a whirlpool of fire. Clear black gaps between the arms, bright yellow cores and red-orange edges, a few embers.

Square canvas, opaque PURE FLAT BLACK #000000 background, the vortex centred and inside the central 82% with black margin all round; nothing touches the image edge. Screen-blend ready: saturated colour with crisp bright cores, glow fading to pure black; no smoke, no grey haze, no explosion, no text, no other objects.

precheck.summary: The candidate shows one clockwise fire vortex with a round disc silhouette, five or six curling orange-gold arms, bright yellow cores, a flat black background, and a few embers. Nothing is cropped by the image edge, and there is no text or extra figures. The outer flames extend slightly past the nominal central 82% margin, which is a minor drift and not a defect.
